steps.text: Hello! I am your AI Guide. I will guide you through each step of the experiment. Please follow the instructions carefully and perform the actions as directed. Before we begin, let us familiarize ourselves with the simulation interface. To start, click on the start walkthrough

The interface walkthrough is now complete. You are now ready to perform the experiment. You may either click the Auto Connect button to make the circuit connections automatically or connect the circuit manually by following the highlighted terminals. Let's begin with the first connection.

steps.text: Connections verified successfully. Now turn ON the MCB by clicking the MCB lever.
MCB has been turned ON. Select the resistor, inductor, and capacitor values from the dropdowns.
Resistor, inductor, and capacitor values have been selected. Now click the power button of the autotransformer.
Autotransformer is now ON. Next, click on the autotransformer knob to set the voltage.

The voltage has been set to 30 V to ensure safe operation of the RLC circuit experiment. The readings are now displayed on the voltmeters, ammeter, and wattmeter. Now click the Add button to add the readings to the observation table.
Reading 1 of 12 has been added. Select a different RLC combination and click the Add button again.
A new RLC value is set. Click the Add button to record it.
Select a different RLC combination to enable the Add button.
Reading 2 of 12 has been added. Repeat the same steps until all 12 readings have been recorded.
All 12 readings have been recorded. Select a recorded reading. Voltage and current are filled automatically. Calculate V R, V L, V C, power factor, and power, then click the Verify button.
This theoretical calculation row has been verified successfully. Verify one more reading to enable report generation.
You can add a maximum of 12 readings to the table.
Two theoretical calculation rows have been verified successfully. You may now generate the report.
Select recorded readings, calculate the theoretical values, and verify two rows before generating the report.
